title: AI Transit raw scan report
description: The JSON report exactly as scan_pipeline.sh emits it today (before tests/conformance/conformance.py normalises it). Written to <report_dir>/report_scan_<name>.json, or to <WORK_DIR>/reports/report_<timestamp>.json. Key order is not part of the contract. Only these keywords are used, and tests/conformance/check_schema.py understands exactly these: type (a name or a list of names), properties, required, additionalProperties (a boolean or a schema), items, enum, pattern, minimum. Annotation keywords ($schema, $id, title, description) are ignored. Rules that cannot be written in that subset (decision follows verdict, coverage_complete follows coverage, summary.fail equals the number of findings) are checked by check_schema.py as 'invariants', and are listed in docs/engine_contract.md section 4.

verdict.description: PASS or FAIL. Never WARN: a WARN does not change the verdict.

decision.description: APPROVED exactly when verdict is PASS, otherwise REJECTED.

scan_name.description: The third positional argument, or the run timestamp (YYYYmmdd_HHMMSS, local time) when it is empty or absent. Stored even when the report file name does not use it (empty report_dir).

directory.description: The directory that was scanned, as given (trailing slashes removed, not resolved).

sha256.description: SHA-256 over the sorted 'sha256sum' lines of every regular file under the directory (excluded directories included). Falls back to repo_hash when the content hash could not be computed.

coverage.description: Per layer: ran, skipped:<reason> or partial:<reason>. L1_ioc_yara is present only when YARA was skipped, and L6_licence is absent when ScanCode was enabled but failed (both are bash behaviour that looks accidental, see docs/engine_contract.md section 11).

coverage_complete.description: True when no coverage entry is anything other than 'ran'.

coverage_gaps.description: The layer ids whose state does not start with 'ran', sorted.

repo_input.description: The REPO_INPUT environment variable (the URL or path ai_transit.sh was given); empty when unset.

repo_hash.description: SHA-256 over the sorted list of file paths (not contents) under the directory.

standards.description: Which rule families this engine applies. The first three, then SCA-CVE when RUN_SCA is 'true', then ScanCode-Licence-Copyright when RUN_SCANCODE is 'true', then the twelve fixed names.

summary.description: Event counters, not file counts: pass counts record_pass calls, warn counts record_warn calls, fail counts FAIL records.

findings.description: One record per FAIL that was not allowlisted and not below --min-severity.

file.description: Relative to the scanned directory; '.' for a finding about the whole directory.

findings_by_file.description: FAIL messages joined with ' | ', keyed by the file path as recorded (the directory as given, '/', the relative path).

file_results.description: Per file (and the pseudo entries __global__ and the directory itself): the status and its messages, each carrying a [WARN] or [FAIL] tag, joined with ' | '.
